QF.id: Cat III AIF Overview and Growth_2

question.text: Hedge Funds in India fall under:

explanation.text: The Logic: Pages 35 and 90-91 of the source describe Category III AIFs as funds that employ diverse or complex trading strategies, may use leverage, and include hedge funds as a representative example. The Trap: Category I and II AIFs target other strategies (venture capital, infrastructure, private equity, debt etc.) and do not accommodate hedge-fund-style trading; mutual funds are governed by a separate SEBI regulation altogether. Note: Hedge funds are the canonical illustration SEBI uses for the Category III bucket.
